title: test(spec): pin proof 4's message-includes leg with a fifth check-mode box
body:
Fixes #18865

Clause-②: no

`delivers()` in `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts` is a conjunction, and proof 4's
check (c) counts a refusal it cannot read as **"no evidence"**, never as proof:

```ts
return issue !== undefined && issue.message.includes(prescription);
```

The left half — "the door refused this write" — is defended by the `ui/ViewItem` fixture,
which asserts the probe raises no `unrecognized_keys` issue at all. So `&&` short-circuits
in it and the RIGHT half is never evaluated. That half is the only thing that separates a
def parsing through its declaration's own error map from a strict CLONE built to the same
declaration without it. Before this PR it was defended by a zero.

The card asserts "no fixture would fire", **not** "it is already broken". This PR does not
claim the leg has ever failed silently in the tree, and it measured no such thing.

## What lands

One fifth sandbox in this harness, built in the shape of the four that already copy `src/`,
plus two cases:

| case | this box's `strictObject` | verdict | exit |
|:--|:--|:--|:--|
| LIT | error map dropped | `declared-but-silent` | 1 |
| DARK | the tree's own bytes | `prescribed`, deletion waived | 0 |

A gate that lost the message conjunct turns the LIT case red and leaves the DARK one green.
⚠️ The failure direction is "reads as compliant" — a defeated leg WAIVES the deletion, it
does not add a "no evidence" row — which is why both directions are pinned, not just one.

## Re-derived, not inherited

Read at branch head `cbb3521fe5` in this worktree, 2026-09-22T22:07Z. The line numbers the
card and its triage comment cite were taken on 2026-09-18 and have all moved; the sites
below are given by shape and by their reading today.

| reading | on `origin/main` `c120dbdfb8` | on `cbb3521fe5` |
|:--|:--|:--|
| harness length | 4531 lines | 4812 lines |
| `it(` cases | 85 | 87 |
| `symlinkSync` sites | 6 | 7 |
| sites whose entry array still names `src` | 1 (the shared `createSandbox`, `:476`) | 1 (unchanged) |
| `cpSync` of `PKG/src` into a box | 4 (`:3438` `:3737` `:4103` `:4367`) | 5 (`:4695` added) |

So the shared `createSandbox` and the 85 cases that run through it are untouched: the diff
is one appended `describe` block and one `import { z } from 'zod'`.

## The pin can fail — ablation, on disk, both legs proven

`node scripts/ablation-replace.mjs` in WRAP mode on `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts`,
anchor `return issue !== undefined && issue.message.includes(prescription);` replaced by
`return issue !== undefined;` — the message leg, and nothing else. 2026-09-22T22:10Z.

```text
anchor   "return issue !== undefined && issue.message.includes(prescription);"  x1 (before)
  anchor hits 1 time(s), as declared
anchor   x1 -> x0
replace  "return issue !== undefined;"  x0 -> x1
blob     c886e1778316b5ff8c3d1780b599e8bcb50c1970 -> 3cccd072c9cfe48685728086055cefef6cb7b52a
ok mutation landed: anchor 1 -> 0, blob c886e1778316 -> 3cccd072c9cf
```

Result, the two cases under `-t '#18865'`:

```text
 × LIT — a strict clone that does not carry its declaration's error map is NOT proof: the deletion is refused
AssertionError: expected +0 to be 1 // Object.is equality
- Expected   1
+ Received   0
 ❯ scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts:4751:22  ->  expect(status).toBe(1)
      Tests  1 failed | 1 passed | 85 skipped (87)
```

The LIT case goes red **for the ablated reason**: with the conjunct gone the gate exits 0 —
it waives the deletion, which is the card's stated failure direction — and the DARK case
stays green, so the pair discriminates "reads the message" from "refuses everything".

Restore, proven on disk rather than by an exit code:

```text
restore packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas.ts
  blob after restore  c886e1778316b5ff8c3d1780b599e8bcb50c1970
  blob at HEAD        c886e1778316b5ff8c3d1780b599e8bcb50c1970
  git diff HEAD       empty
ok restored: blob == HEAD (c886e1778316) and `git diff HEAD` is empty
```

Green again on restore: the full 87-case run below passes both cases with the generator back
at its HEAD bytes.

## Route A stays out, measured

`@objectstack/spec`'s `files[]` carries `src/**/*.zod.ts`, so a synthetic def written into
the real `src/` would ship in the tarball. This fixture writes only into the BOX's own copy
of `src/`, and the repo's `src/` is never touched. `npm pack --dry-run --json` on a real
build of `@objectstack/spec` (built at 2026-09-22T22:16Z), run on this branch and again with
the one changed file restored to `c120dbdfb8`:

| | entries | diff |
|:--|--:|:--|
| before (`c120dbdfb8` bytes of the one changed file) | 2031 | — |
| after (this branch) | 2031 | byte-identical file lists, `diff` exit 0, 0 lines |

Controls on the after list:

- POSITIVE — `src/shared/http.zod.ts` present, `src/system/stack-server.zod.ts` present,
  204 `src/` entries in all: the instrument does reach the directory a route-A fixture would
  have landed in.
- NEGATIVE — `scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` absent; `scripts/` contributes 0
  entries; `src/shared/strict-object.ts` (not a `.zod.ts`) absent.
- DARK — `src/shared/http.zod.tsx`, a name that does not exist, absent.

The file this PR changes is the only file it changes, and it publishes nothing.

## The cost this adds, measured here, and what the measurement can and cannot resolve

Both runs: `vitest run --project repo scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts --reporter=verbose`,
through the shared heavy-verify lock on one **shared** 4-core box with sibling agents active —
the before arm queued 123s behind another locked run and the after arm queued 161s, so these are
shared-box seconds, not idle-box figures. The two trees differ in exactly the one file.

| arm | tree | cases | vitest `Duration` |
|:--|:--|--:|--:|
| before | the one changed file at `c120dbdfb8` (blob `18100c70f8`, 4531 lines) | 85 | 632.50 s |
| after | this branch (blob `326a8c9466`, 4812 lines) | 87 | 646.38 s |

Whole-suite delta: **+13.88 s (+2.19 %)**. ⚠️ That number is **NOT distinguishable from
run-to-run noise**, and it is not the cost. The control for it is inside the same pair: the
**85 cases that are byte-identical in both arms** summed **623.31 s** in the after run and
**625.88 s** in the before run — the unchanged work measured **2.57 s FASTER** in the arm that
was supposed to be slower, and its summed per-case absolute drift was **31.05 s** (median
290 ms, p90 720 ms, max 1352 ms per case). A 13.88 s whole-run delta sits inside that.

The figure that IS resolvable is the direct one: the two new cases are new work and were timed
individually — **7.803 s + 8.342 s = 16.14 s**, **2.50 %** of the after run. Both land between
this harness's own p75 (7.405 s) and its max (19.08 s), against a per-case mean of 7.35 s, which
is what two ordinary gate spawns cost here; the one extra `src` copy this box pays is not
separately resolvable at that scale. Sandbox construction is not where this harness spends its
time — 87 gate spawns are.

Plainly: the box costs about **two cases' worth**, the suite total moved by less than its own
noise, and nothing here supports quoting the whole-run delta as a cost.

## Verification

- `pnpm exec vitest run --project repo scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts` — **87 passed
  (87)**, exit 0, 2026-09-22T22:41Z. The `build-schemas-check-mode` case count moves **85 to 87**.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec test` — the `local` project, which is where the package's
  `test` script points; this harness is in the `repo` project and is run separately above.
  **515 files passed, 15043 passed | 1 todo (15044)**, exit 0, 183.81 s, 2026-09-22T22:59Z.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/spec typecheck` — exit 0, 50 s, same window.
- Gate families derived from **this worktree** with
  `node scripts/pm/dispatch-gates.mjs --repo objectstack-ai/objectstack --commands` (it reports
  the tree it read: `objectstack-ai/objectstack` at `cbb3521fe5`, 1 changed path, 281 changed
  lines). **57 commands, each exit code captured before any pipe**: **54 exit 0**, **3 exit 3**.
- The three exit-3 rows are **NOT MEASURED, and NOT a pass**: `check:dual-build-cjs-loads`,
  `check:lean-entry-closure` and `check:type-check-debt` each print `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` and
  refuse because this worktree has `dist/` for `@objectstack/spec` only. Each reads BUILT output
  of packages this diff does not touch; the reading CI takes on a fully built tree is the one
  that counts. Reconciled with `--ran`.
- `dispatch-gates.mjs` also names, as outside those 57 and therefore unmeasured here: 58
  artifact-roster families whose `silent` verdict is a fact about a list, 11 wide-population
  families, 9 that apply once a changeset exists, 7 that take a value from the workflow, 5
  path-scheduled CI jobs and 4 type-check lanes. Its own words: that silence is not a clearance.

## Changeset

This diff changes one file, `packages/spec/scripts/build-schemas-check-mode.test.ts`, and it
publishes nothing: measured, not argued — `npm pack --dry-run` lists **2031 entries and 0 under
`scripts/`**, and the list is byte-identical to the one taken with that file restored to
`c120dbdfb8`.

The changeset gate's own route 0 discriminator,
`git diff --name-status c120dbdfb8...HEAD -- '.changeset/*.md'`, returns **nothing** — this PR
neither adds nor corrects a changeset — so route 0 does not match and the gate's prescription is
its **route 2**, quoted from `.github/workflows/pr-automation.yml`:

```text
  2. It releases nothing (.github/, .claude/, skills/, docs/, content/,
     examples/, tests-only, and the like)
     -> apply the 'skip-changeset' label.
```

(the workflow marks that last line PREFERRED; the marker is dropped from the quote above
only because its arrow characters do not survive a GitHub body intact.)

⛔ This round applies no label. The prescription is reported here for the owning seat to act on.

## Acceptance notes

Observations, none of them filed and none of them fixed here — this PR's scope is this card:

- Every line number the card body and its triage comment cite has moved (the harness is 4531
  lines on `origin/main`, not the 4466 the card cites), which is why every site above is given
  by shape and re-derived. Nothing in the tree is wrong; a line number is simply not an anchor.
- The card's stated route-B blocker ("the fixture def can only be written into the real `src`")
  is false for four of the five sandboxes, which already copy `src/` privately. That is what
  made a fifth box possible without touching `createSandbox`.
- ⛔ Still unmeasured, exactly as the card left it: how many OTHER fail-closed legs of proof 4
  are in the same undefended state, and whether this leg has ever actually failed silently in
  the tree. This PR pins one leg and claims nothing about a population.
